content.text: A Game of Thrones The Card Game is a commercial customizable card game of political conflict, deck construction, plot selection, and challenges between Westeros factions.
The game began as a collectible or living card game adaptation of George R. R. Martins setting and later received a second edition with revised card pools and rules.
Players bring constructed faction decks and plot decks.
Use legal commercial decks, faction cards, agendas, and plot cards.
Commercial customizable decks, faction cards, agendas, and plot cards, score area, and enough table space for play.
Set faction materials, shuffle draw decks, prepare plot decks, and draw opening hands according to edition rules.
